purpose: Measure which declared validation families detect a bounded, deliberately selected set of semantic source defects; identify surviving defects and blind spots.
selection: The investigator inspected production source, existing tests, and frozen case descriptions before selecting operators. Operators are purposive and informed by contract boundaries, not randomly sampled real-world defects. None of the mutant outcomes was observed before the freeze.
control: Unmodified complete production Python package, copied into the same isolated layout as mutants.
mutation_application: Each mutant replaces exactly one unique source anchor in one copied module. No production source is altered. All copied Python files and exact patch text are hashed before any evaluation.

families.metamorphic: All 120 previously frozen property cases and all six transformations: 720 dependent property instances. Existing evaluator used unchanged. Results split by property. Input nonmutation checks retained separately.
families.quarter_grid: All 1625 previously frozen quarter-grid cells. Existing independent integer-coordinate oracle and evaluator used unchanged.
families.certificate_grid: All 360 previously frozen certificate cases and all 186 probes each, totaling 66960 dependent case-probe decisions. Existing frozen expected.json is authoritative; existing rows_from_case/predict helpers are reused. Each failed case retains a first concrete mismatch. An exception at case construction produces one error case and 186 unassessed probes; it is not counted as 186 incorrect predictions.
families.targeted_stability: All nine methods from existing tests/test_stability.py, unchanged. The counting unit is a unittest method, including existing internal loops; no count inflation from those loops. Failure tracebacks retained. No new tests are added to the scored suite.

scope_rule: Comparison-only property and quarter-grid families are not run for stability.py-only mutations because they cannot import or call changed code. These cells are explicitly not assessed, not passes. All other families run for every variant; no-detection does not imply relevant assertions or adequate input coverage.
detection: A mutant is detected by a family if an existing assertion/oracle comparison fails or the mutant raises an unexpected exception. Record mismatches and runtime errors separately. The unmodified control must pass all families; otherwise interpretation is blocked.
denominator: All 12 syntactically valid seeded mutants remain in the union detection denominator, including survivors and mutants outside a family's domain. Remove only a demonstrably equivalent mutant with a retained proof; no such removal is planned. Cross-family failure proportions are not comparable accuracy estimates because the counting units differ.
activation_witnesses: Each operator includes a predeclared small input showing the intended semantic effect. Witnesses are run after the existing-suite evaluation and compared against the unmodified control solely to distinguish non-equivalent mutants from ineffective patches. They are excluded from every detection score. A surviving non-equivalent mutant remains a survivor and motivates future coverage rather than retrospective test tuning.
execution: Freeze command first; run command refuses source/input/harness hash drift. Each variant executes in a fresh subprocess with only its isolated src first on sys.path. No timing benchmark is repeated. No outcome-driven sampling, patch repair, or operator replacement is permitted within this freeze.
precision: Exact equality for discrete decisions and rational numerator/denominator output. No numerical tolerance is applied.
limitations: Finite constructed dependent cases, informed operator selection, selected modules, and a selected existing test file. This is not a proof, fault-population accuracy estimate, independent preregistration, or evidence about radiation reliability. Existing broad core/adversarial tests are outside this bounded experiment, so a survivor is a blind spot in the four selected families rather than in the complete project test suite.
